Hook "useThing" returns "count" with an inconsistent shape across branches. Each slot must consistently be a plain value or the same reactive accessor kind so consumers can be rewritten safely: return a plain value from every branch (e.g. { count: count() }) or a compatible accessor from every branch (e.g. { count: () => 'off' }).
